# St. Thomas Syro-Malabar Catholic Church, Chempu

> Official knowledge base and AI summary specification for search engines, LLM agents, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google Gemini, and Apple Intelligence.
> Domain: https://stthomasrcchurchchempu.in

## Overview
- **Name:** St. Thomas Syro-Malabar Roman Catholic Church, Chempu (ചെമ്പ് സെന്റ് തോമസ് പള്ളി)
- **Denomination:** Syro-Malabar Major Archiepiscopal Catholic Church (Sui Iuris, Eastern Catholic Church in full communion with the Pope in Rome)
- **Hierarchy:** Archdiocese of Ernakulam-Angamaly • Vaikom Forane
- **Established:** 1307 AD (Over 700+ years of continuous apostolic Christian history)
- **Patron Saint:** Apostle St. Thomas (Apostle of India, affectionately known as Chempu Muthappan)
- **Native Historical Figure:** Birthplace and native parish of Servant of God Mar Augustine Kandathil (1874–1956), the first indigenous Metropolitan Archbishop of India and founding father of the Syro-Malabar hierarchy.
- **Location:** Chempu P.O., Vaikom, Kottayam District, Kerala - 686 615, India. Situated along the serene backwaters of Vembanad Lake near Vaikom.

## Liturgy & Holy Mass Timings
- **Sunday Holy Qurbana:** 07:00 AM & 09:15 AM
- **Sunday Catechism & Faith Formation:** 10:30 AM – 12:15 PM
- **Daily Holy Qurbana:**
  - Monday – Wednesday: 06:15 AM
  - Thursday: 05:15 PM (followed by Novena to St. Thomas at 06:15 PM)
  - Friday – Saturday: 06:15 AM
- **Confession:** Every Saturday from 05:00 PM onwards and before Holy Qurbana.

## Annual Feasts & Thirunal
1. **Feast of St. Thomas the Apostle (Dukhrana):** July 3 & traditional Parish Thirunal. Grand annual feast with Kodiyettu (flag-hoisting), solemn Raza Qurbana, Muthukkuda (ceremonial silk umbrellas) procession, and Snehabhojanam.
2. **Feast of St. Sebastian (അമ്പു തിരുനാൾ / Ambu Thirunal):** Celebrated on the Sunday following January 20th, featuring the traditional solemn arrow procession through all 12 parish ward units.
3. **Feast of St. Joseph (ഊട്ടുനേർച്ച / Oottu Nercha):** March 19th, featuring the grand communal fellowship banquet serving over 1,500+ faithful and pilgrims.
4. **Holy Week & Easter:** Solemn Paschal Triduum, Pesaha Holy Thursday, Passion Friday, and the Glorious Resurrection.
5. **Christmas (Feast of Nativity):** December 25th with Midnight Holy Qurbana and ward carol visits.
